source_text: Qui idolatriae tenebris derelictis ad audientiam legis accedis, Aegyptum derelinquis. Catechumenis aggregatus mare rubrum digressus es et in deserto Moysi vultum revelatum cotidianis vacas. Si ad mysticum baptismi fontem veneris sacerdote et Levitico ordine consistente, Iordane digresso terram repromissionis intrabis, ubi post Moysen Iesus novi itineris dux. Memor virtutum Dei dices: Quid tibi est mare quod fugisti? et tu Iordanis quia conversus es retrorsum? Respondebit: A facie Domini commota est terra.
pass_a_gloss: Who of-idolatry darknesss having-left unto hearing of-law you-approach, Egypt you-leave. To-catechumens joined Red Sea you-have-passed and in desert of-Moses face revealed to-daily-things you-devote. If unto mystical of-baptism font you-shall-have-come with-priest and Levitical order standing, Jordan having-passed land of-promise you-will-enter, where after Moses Jesus of-new journey leader. Mindful of-powers of-God you-will-say: What to-you is sea that you-fled? and you Jordan that you-were-turned backward? Will-answer: From face of-Lord moved-is earth.
pass_b_english: You who leave idolatry’s darkness to hear the divine law are leaving Egypt. Enrolled among the catechumens you have crossed the Red Sea and in the desert stations daily attend Moses’ face unveiled by the Lord’s glory. When you come to baptism’s mystic font with priestly and Levitical order standing by, and pass the Jordan, you will enter the land of promise, where after Moses Jesus becomes guide of a new road. Mindful of God’s mighty acts you will say: [[What ails you, O sea, that you fled? And you, O Jordan, that you turned back? >> Bible:Psalm 114:5]]. The word answers: [[At the Lord’s presence the earth trembled >> Bible:Psalm 114:7]].
